sentence: The backyard is buried in leaves and dead weeds. Clean it all up.

observation.model_notes: Photo 2 shows a stack of cut lumber/wood scraps in the foreground and a metal-framed object near the garden bed — these look like discarded building material, not tree branches or yard debris covered by the requested cleanup; flag with the customer if removal of that material is wanted. Front yard and side yard are not shown in either photo, so no scope can be reported for those sections.

supporting_evidence.note: Dry, dead weeds/tall grass densely covering the open ground area beyond the garden bed border, extending across most of the visible yard floor.

evidence.note: Ground is completely blanketed in a thick layer of dead leaves from the foreground all the way back to the tree line, with grass barely visible underneath.
Foreground and mid-ground covered in dense, dried-out dead weeds/tall grass, waist-high in places.
